cycle_title: Rescue the L1 proof-critic review and draft the T-004 KL dominance bridge
completed: Copied the proof-critic review of Lemma 1.1 from the unmerged draft PR #10 branch into docs/proofs/reviews/ so the only completed adversarial review in the project is no longer held inside an open draft PR.
Recorded the received review and its REVISE disposition in docs/proof_review_log.md, replacing the 'Reviewer-2 critique: Pending' state of the prior entry.

Drafted docs/proofs/L3_kl_dominance.md for backlog item T-004 with exact model classes, a declared comparison unit, the risk-divergence decomposition, the KL-to-log-score identity, a nesting proposition, a first-order sufficient condition for strict dominance, and a downstream contract corollary.
Proposed decision-gated A-009 (common comparison unit and design distribution) and A-010 (kernel non-degeneracy) in the assumption register and the proposed-assumptions record.
Moved T-004 from backlog to proof-draft, updated T-001 to record the received review, annotated T-007 with the now-precise definition of Delta ell, and added proposed backlog item T-008.
Recorded a correction: boundary case 1 as currently written in the project context and theorem backlog is stronger than the mathematics supports.
why_it_matters: The KL bridge is the load-bearing link between the mixture lemma and every model-selection consequence, and it was the largest piece of theory that no decision gate was blocking.

The draft establishes that under a nested false-complex model the sign of the KL gap holds for every data-generating process, so Result 3 cannot by itself carry the project thesis; the weight must move to the finite-sample and Bayesian criteria.

Corollary L3.5 gives the mathematical reason for the repository's existing rule that LOOIC and Bayes-factor results may not be inferred from the KL bridge, replacing a procedural guardrail with a stated argument.

Proposition L3.4 yields a score statistic the simulation track can estimate without fitting the complex model, which gives a cheap theorem-aligned screen over candidate false-complex parameterizations.

decision_needed.question: Does the primary false-complex empirical model M_K nest the context-omitting simple model M_S, so that M_S is recovered by setting the extra source, colour, condition, and nonlinear ambiguity parameters to zero?
options: Yes, M_K nests M_S. Accept that the sign of the KL gap is automatic (Proposition L3.3), stop presenting Result 3 as a theorem about context omission, and move the theorem package's weight to the magnitude of Delta ell and to T-005/T-006/T-007.

No, M_K is a genuinely non-nested alternative architecture. Proposition L3.3 does not apply, strict KL dominance becomes a substantive claim, and a separate sufficient condition must be drafted from the L2 Gaussian mixture.
Undecided pending the choice of the primary false-complex model, which is itself a standing PI gate.
decision_needed.default_if_no_response: Treat T-004 as a conditional draft, do not cite Result 3 as evidence for the thesis in any manuscript text, and do not send L3 for proof-critic review until the nesting status is fixed.

procedure_compliance.notes: No claim status was promoted; C-004 remains planned and C-002 remains in_progress. Two new theorem assumptions are proposed with status decision_needed rather than adopted, following the A-007/A-008 pattern. No estimand change, false-complex model selection, causal claim, literature claim, restricted data, or expensive compute is involved. The cycle covers two items rather than one because the review rescue is a verbatim copy of already-reviewed content rather than new scientific work.

risks_or_uncertainties: T-004 rests on Lemma 1.1, which is itself under revision for findings F1 and F2, so L3 inherits that status and its participant-level instantiation is unavailable until the joint-mixture target is derived.

Counter-example CE-1 shows a complex-model win is consistent with plain trial-level misspecification and no omitted context at all, so neither the simulation nor the empirical design may read a positive KL or log-score gap as evidence of context omission.

Counter-example CE-2 shows the theorem route omits the context-aware versus false-complex contrast that claim C-001 asserts, while the Bayesian comparison plan already lists it as an empirical contrast; proposed T-008 records the asymmetry but does not resolve it.

Boundary case 1 as written in docs/current_project_context.md and docs/theorem_backlog.md overstates what follows from a null context effect; the correction is stated in L3 section 5 but those two files were left unedited to keep this cycle bounded.

A-009 and A-010 are appended to the assumption register at the same location where the open draft PR #10 appends A-007 and A-008, so a textual merge conflict at the end of that file is expected and should be resolved by keeping all four rows.
next_bounded_task: Obtain the PI decision on M_K nesting, then either send L3 for proof-critic review or draft a non-nested sufficient condition for strict KL dominance built on the L2 Gaussian mixture.
